title: Soak Squad
hook: Grab a bucket, fill your soaker, then soak your friends and claim the whole yard in your colour.
prompt: a backyard water fight with friends where you spray your colour all over the lawn

round.winBy: most lawn claimed plus points stolen when time is up

mechanics.as: your water soaker, limited by its tank
water buckets that refill your tank
claim the lawn by soaking it

rules.summary: Buckets fill your water tank. Hold fire to spray: soaking ground or props claims them in your colour, and soaking a friend knocks them about and steals some of their points. An empty tank means no spray until you grab another bucket. Most points when the bell rings wins.
rules.scoring: +1 per claimed patch, steal 2 points per soaking

characters.describe: a round jelly-bean kid in swim goggles

content.notes: A cartoon water fight: beans get soaked and knocked about, nobody is hurt.

accept: your spray paints the lawn and soaks friends
